**Trade Offer — x402 Purchase**

**From:** Hannah White, Crypto Trading Desk
**To:** x402 Liquidity Counterparty
**Subject:** Firm Purchase Offer — 45,010 Units

---

Good day,

I am writing to place a firm purchase offer for **45,010 units on x402**.

**Offer Terms:**

| Parameter | Detail |
|---|---|
| Asset | x402 |
| Direction | Buy |
| Quantity | 45,010 units |
| Order Type | Firm offer |
| Execution | Full fill preferred; partial acceptable above 60% |
| Settlement | Standard network settlement, T+0 |
| Price | Quote required — will confirm on receipt |

**Conditions:**
- Offer valid for **30 minutes** from timestamp of this message.
- Counterparty must confirm available liquidity prior to price lock.
- Slippage tolerance is tight; I am not chasing a moving book.
- All execution subject to standard KYC/AML verification on both sides.

I trade on clarity, not on noise. Present a clean quote and we execute. Present a vague one and I walk.

Send your bid-side confirmation and price. I will respond promptly.

Regards,

**Hannah White**
Crypto Trader
*Positions taken with conviction. Exits taken with discipline.*
